title: A present PAYMENT-RESPONSE that does not decode neither commits nor releases
description: SPEC §6.7 makes a 2xx paid-success 'only when any required upstream PAYMENT-RESPONSE parses successfully', and forgives *missing* metadata because the pinned protocol marks the header optional. A header that is present and does not decode is neither: it is a protocol violation, and it is evidence in no direction at all. It cannot commit, because parsing is a precondition of paid-success; it cannot release, because a merchant that plainly attempted to report a settlement has not told us there was none. Retention is the only disposition left, and it holds on every status — the 200 case is the one that used to return the resource as a paid success, which the audit filed as O53. Contrast the absent-settlement-evidence-commits vector: the same call with no header at all commits and delivers, which is why the two evidence values had to stop being one.
